ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: According to Figure 1, the substance shown in Figure 1 cannot represent ______.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: on the left side of the figure is a phosphate group containing P and multiple O atoms, and it is labeled O⁻; connected in the middle is a five-carbon sugar structure with a five-membered ring; connected on the right side is a nitrogen-containing base containing multiple N atoms. The three parts are connected together, conforming to the nucleotide structure of “phosphate group + five-carbon sugar + nitrogen-containing base.” Then reason: a nucleotide can represent the basic constituent unit of nucleic acids or certain nucleotide-type substances; whereas the monomer of proteins is an amino acid, and an amino acid should have structures such as an amino group and a carboxyl group, not the nucleotide structure in the figure. Therefore, the substance shown in Figure 1 cannot represent the monomer that constitutes proteins.

method.method_draft: 先观察图像：左侧是带负电的磷酸基团，中间是五碳糖，右侧连接一个含氮碱基，三者组合成一个核苷酸。再读取题干要求“图1所示物质不能表示什么”。利用核苷酸与氨基酸的结构和功能区别判断：该图可表示核酸的单体或某些核苷酸类物质，但不能表示蛋白质的单体，因为蛋白质的单体应是氨基酸。答案填“构成蛋白质的单体”。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中左侧是一个含P和多个O的磷酸基团，并标有O⁻；中间连接的是一个五元环的五碳糖结构；右侧连接的是含多个N原子的含氮碱基。三部分连接在一起，符合“磷酸基团＋五碳糖＋含氮碱基”的核苷酸结构。再推理：核苷酸可以表示核酸的基本组成单位或某些核苷酸类物质；而蛋白质的单体是氨基酸，氨基酸应具有氨基和羧基等结构，不是图中的核苷酸结构。因此图1所示物质不能表示构成蛋白质的单体。
